parsed.main_gap: The central quantitative estimate (7) is asserted with "details omitted"; the squaring/rearranging computation that is the heart of the argument is never carried out.

errors.description: Key Lipschitz-type bound (7) — the crux of the whole proof — is stated without derivation. It is in fact true and follows in two lines from the AM–GM (lower) inequality with x=f(t), plus swapping t and y, but the write-up supplies none of this and does not indicate which inequality yields which side.

errors.description: Minor inaccuracy in the stated method: the bound (7) follows from the lower (AM–GM) inequality alone, and the hypotheses b,c\ge 0 are not needed; the upper inequality plays no role. This misdescription further obscures the omitted computation.

parsed.notes: Answer f(x)=x+C, C≥0 is correct. Substitution x=f(y), the iterate law f^n(t)=t+nd(t), positivity forcing d≥0, the telescoping-to-constant argument, and the converse are all correct and cleanly written. Only the omitted (but genuinely short) derivation of (7) prevents a 7.
